duas.title: Supplications
duas.subtitle: Call upon Me, I will respond to you

1.title: Dua of Istikhara
1.text: O Allah, I seek the better choice through Your knowledge, and I seek ability through Your power, and I ask You from Your immense bounty. You are capable while I am not, and You know while I do not, and You are the Knower of the unseen.

2.title: Dua for worry and grief
2.text: O Allah, I am Your servant, the son of Your servant and the son of Your maidservant. My forelock is in Your hand; Your command over me is forever executed, and Your decree over me is just.

3.title: Dua of Prophet Musa
3.text: My Lord, expand for me my chest, ease for me my task, and untie the knot from my tongue so that they may understand my speech.

4.title: Dua of Prophet Yunus
4.text: There is no deity except You. Glory be to You! Indeed, I have been among the wrongdoers.

5.title: Dua for goodness
5.text: Our Lord, grant us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the torment of the Fire.

6.title: Morning and evening Dua
6.text: O Allah, I have entered the morning calling You, the bearers of Your Throne, Your angels, and all Your creation to witness that You alone are Allah and that there is no deity except You, without partner.

7.title: Dua for provision
7.text: O Allah, suffice me with what You have made lawful instead of what You have forbidden, and make me independent by Your bounty from all others besides You.

8.title: Dua for relief
8.text: My Lord, I am truly in need of whatever good You send down to me.
